verdict.rationale: INPI's homepage points to its own searchable databases, which plausibly let a founder find a filing's record. However, nothing in the evidence says those public pages show the status of an application or case. A keyless probe of the data.inpi.fr open-data portal returned HTTP 403, which suggests IP data access there needs an account-issued token rather than being fully public. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that filing/application/case status is shown on public pages, lookup by application number, coverage across trademarks/patents/designs, and hands-on confirmation that unauthenticated public status lookup works.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: Effectuez des recherches rapides et ciblées grâce à nos bases de données.
